severity_reconciliation.policy: Do not sum original major/minor verdicts. Audits a/c call evidence-only benefit retention major for table projection, while audit b calls the same preserved text a minor representation defect. Original judgments are retained; no aggregate severity or model error rate is asserted.

audit_a.json.major: Material incorrect fact, complete loss of useful source restriction, or economically/usefully material benefit unavailable in semantic fields for direct table projection. Evidence-only preservation explicitly distinguished from total loss.
audit_a.json.minor: Information mainly preserved but field placement, scope qualification, repetition, technical wording or secondary clause deficient.
audit_a.json.pass: No identified defect against supplied evidence; does not certify personal eligibility, current live offer availability or complete hidden conditions.

audit_b.json.major: Material rate/scope/benefit loss or unresolved source contradiction affecting terms.
audit_b.json.minor: Formatting/provenance/field-semantics/advice issue; qualitative benefit kept in evidence but not independently represented is flagged minor to avoid claiming total textual data loss.

audit_c.json.major: Material benefit/qualifier absent from semantic fields or scope materially altered; evidence-only retention is explicitly distinguished from complete textual loss. Automatic publication not safe without repair.
audit_c.json.minor: Facts substantially preserved but representation, provenance labels, language, unsupported wording, or repetition needs correction. Not an error-rate estimate for unseen offers.
